पेचक पेचक, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1.
पच्), an owl; the tip or the root of an elephant's
tail; a couch, bed; a louse; a cloud; (इका), f. a
kind of owl.
पेचकिन्, ई, m. an elephant; (also read पिचकिन्.)

पेचु पेचु, उ, n. or पेचुली, f. a species of bul-
bous plant with esculent roots, Colocasia Antiquorum.
